In this contribution the technical background information for BS is captured as reference for the IAB-Node requirement specification work. The reference sensitivity requirement for BS is defined for 1-C, 1-H, 1-O and 2-O. The concepts for 1-C and 1-H is exactly the same, while the concept for 1-O and 2-O are different. For FR1 IAB-Node it is reasonable to use the requirement concept from 1-H and 1-O, depending on IAB-Node type. For IAB-Node type 2-O, the BS concept of using a declared EIS met within a declared RoAoA can be adopted for both the DU and MT. Such a requirement would capture the array antenna capability and allow for various types of implementations. In this contribution the technical background information for BS is captured as reference for the IAB-Node requirement specification work. The reference sensitivity requirement for BS is defined for 1-C, 1-H, 1-O and 2-O. The concepts for 1-C and 1-H is exactly the same, while the concept for 1-O and 2-O are different. For FR1 IAB-Node it is reasonable to use the requirement concept from 1-H and 1-O, depending on IAB-Node type. For IAB-Node type 2-O, the BS concept of using a declared EIS met within a declared RoAoA can be adopted for both the DU and MT. Such a requirement would capture the array antenna capability and allow for various types of implementations.
